title: HashiCorp Nomad and Nomad Enterprise are vulnerable to cross-namespace authorization bypasses in several read-only API…
description: HashiCorp Nomad and Nomad Enterprise contain a vulnerability allowing authenticated users with read permissions in one namespace to bypass authorization controls and view information in other namespaces via several read-only API endpoints. This issue is identified as CVE-2026-102260 and has a medium severity rating. The vulnerability is fixed in Nomad Community Edition 2.1.0 and Nomad Enterprise versions 2.1.0, 1.11.12, and 1.10.18.
